datePolicy: Do not publish a catalyst date unless it is backed by an official exchange, issuer, regulator, or government source URL.

calendarGate.readyRule: A calendar item is REAL only when the official URL, issuer, event type, source date, market date, and analyst action agree.

starterActions: Check ADX and DFM disclosure pages each morning before market-open research.
Record unverified expected windows as watch items, not dated events.
Move a watch item to REAL only after official source capture.
Attach each REAL event to a question template, memo packet, or decision journal entry.
